Overview

Overview:

The Business Consultant leads and mentors the Service Delivery team in all Tier 1 (Basic) and Tier 2 (Intermediate) consulting initiatives. The position provides in-depth and comprehensive subject matter expertise related to Burgess products (from basic to advanced features/functionality), payment methodologies/policies (Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial), payment integrity, and healthcare plan operations (e.g., claim life cycle/workflow, network contracting, payment/policy configuration, provider relations, medical management, medical economics, audit, compliance) related to implementation/consulting engagements, strategic user adoption initiatives, and ongoing client support.

What you will do:

Education and Consulting (implementation/consulting engagements, strategic user adoption initiatives, and on-going client support)

  • Provide the highest level of product education (from basic to advanced features/functionality to Burgess end-users
  • Provide in-depth and comprehensive subject matter expertise related to:
  • Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payment methodologies/policies
  • Payment integrity
  • Healthcare plan operations (e.g., claim adjudication life cycle/workflows, network contracting, payment/policy related configuration, provider relations, medical management, medical economics, audit, compliance)
  • Conduct collaborative scoping sessions to identify client needs and appropriate solutions
  • Actively manage and/or participate in the development, maintenance, and execution of client facing education services 

 

Enhancement/Issue Escalation

  • Manage issues, questions, inquiries of Tier 1 and 2 escalation
  • Serve as escalation point for critical client needs as warranted.
  • Lead diagnosis and resolution of escalated and more involved/complex client problems and issues.
  • Act as a liaison between clients and internal support staff (research, development, and product teams) to assure accurate problem interpretation and resolution.
  • Capture and solicit issues/feedback from clients and internal stakeholders and document issues and client impacts.
  • Partner with appropriate Burgess Teams (BA, PM, Development, Account Management, Sales/Business Development, Product, Content, and Service Delivery) to manage problem framing, diagnosis and resolution.
  • Conduct/participate in root cause analysis to identify and deliver warranted service improvements.
  • Maintain demeanor as a calming influence during pressure situations, mixing in the correct degree of professional assertiveness without becoming aggressive.
  • Maintain communication with customers during the problem resolution process, utilizing superior customer service skills.

 

Capability/Tool Development/Maintenance

  • Leverage capabilities and tools (knowledge libraries, workflow, issue identification and documentation, function processes).
  • Lead capability and tool development under direction of Service Delivery Leadership.

 

Staff/Team Management/Supervision

  • Mentor and provide oversight for Tier 1 and 2 Service Delivery staff
  • Take direction from and collaborate with Service Delivery Leadership to continually review and enhance performance and strategy.

 

What You Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a business, health services administration, mathematics, science or related field, and/or equivalent work experience required.
  • AHIP, HFMA, AAPC, and/or AHIMA certification preferred.
  • 5+ years training, education, and/or consulting experience preferred.
  • Practical understanding of the healthcare system with regards to Medicare, Medicaid, managed care, and commercial payment methodologies, payment integrity, and health plan operations (e.g., claim life cycle/workflows, network contracting, payment/policy related configuration, provider relations, medical management, medical economics, audit, compliance).
  • Experience with interpretation/translation of complex health-plan in-network and out-of-network provider rate and/or claim editing provisions.
  • Experience with configuration and maintenance of provider rate and/or claim editing provisions in a claims adjudication system and/or third-party vendor application.
  • Working knowledge of claim billing specifications (e.g., CMS-1500, UB-04, 837, HIPAA code sets).
  • Creative problem-solving skills including the ability to identify, recommend, and implement strategic solutions.
  • Ability to manage issues, requests, problems, and situations of all Tier 1 and 2 escalation levels.
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct education/training sessions to large audiences across multiple skill levels.
  • Strong analytical skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication (both written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to learn and adapt to new technologies and systems.
  • Ability to adapt to a changing and rapidly growing environment.
  • Effectively manage multiple priorities and follow through on all projects to completion.

 

Who You Are:

  • Creative entrepreneur. You have a constant drive to make things better; you question the status quo and approach common challenges with creativity and constructive criticism. You have skills to clearly and convincingly share ideas in a way that adapts to your audience, regardless of function, level, or expertise.
  • Critical, big-picture thinker. You have a constant thirst for knowledge and the ability to credibly share it with others, whether internally or externally. You are analytical, evaluating logic-based details while always considering and problem solving for the sake of the big picture.
  • Self-starter. You are proactive, self-motivated, and able to push work, start initiatives, and provide ideas independently in a team environment.
  • Team player & coach. You can foster professional and personal respect from others and find success in a team setting. While highly collaborative, you have natural management skills and know how to grow and develop people.
  • Adaptable multi-tasker. You are highly organized and flexible. You know how to manage expectations and are able to thrive in fast-paced, constantly changing environments and successfully adapt to a variety of tasks.

 

How We Work:

  • Collaborative. We work together and help each other do our best by building on our work across teams and offices. We don’t own individual ideas or seek credit.
  • User-driven. We place our clients and our users’ needs above all else. If it matters to a user, it matters to us. We work for them and keep ourselves accountable to that.
  • Hands-on. We don’t wait for problems to solve themselves. We enter the thick of it and get things done.
  • Impact over ego. Our culture is about results, not ownership. Great ideas have seniority over titles and levels, and great thinkers outshine fancy pedigrees.
  • Forward-looking. We look beyond our own world to constantly improve our business. We welcome outside speakers, tap into the latest tech, and make sure we’re future proof in anticipation of what’s coming next.
  • Caring & close knit. We know and care about our people. We know each other’s project strengths—but also about upcoming family trips and favorite after work drinks

Geographic Responsibility: Remote, US

  • Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.

  • May require travel dependent on company needs.

This is a remote position.

Business Operations Manager
Remote (India) | Full-time
Also searched as: Operations Manager, Business Operations Lead, PMO Manager, Project Operations Manager, Shared Services Manager, GCC Operations Manager.
Could you lead ops coordinators, project managers and service teams while carrying real projects alongside them?
On a typical day you might run the planning call for a cross-team project you are leading, review a dashboard showing which requests are running late, sit with a pod lead to rebuild an estimate that looks twice as long as the last similar job, and agree with the Internal Product team which manual handoff to automate next.
About Contour

We operate across three brands. The India team, part of the Global Enablement and Support pillar, is the global capability centre (GCC) Contour is building. It runs delivery, automation, people and operations for the whole organisation, working closely with teams in Australia.
The kind of people who thrive here
Contour started in 2020 as one classroom in a university library. In 2022 three full-time team members ran the business on. Today we are about 600 people across Australia and India, and much of what we run was built by someone who noticed it was missing.
The work matters. More than 10,000 students rely on what we build, from the booklets they study from to the systems their families pay through. People who do well here care about that.
They own their work end to end, start things without being asked and finish what they commit to. They tell the truth early, write decisions down and give direct feedback. The pace is fast: small problems are fixed the same week, bigger ones within the six-week cycle. Growth follows what you deliver: scope, title and pay move with the bar you raise.
About this role
You lead Operations in Contour's India team: several teams brought together under one player-coach. Your team includes Contour’s operations coordinators, who keep academics, campus, finance and the founder’s office running day to day, and its project coordinators and managers, who run cross-team work across the business. It also covers organisation services such as print operations, procurement and workspace systems.
Each service has two sides. In Australia, a functional owner, such as Finance or Academics, sets its standards and priorities. In India, you run the work: coordinators and project managers report to you directly, and any service big enough for its own pod lead reports through them. Everything else is yours: how work comes in, how it is planned, checked and automated, and how the people doing it grow.
Two things separate a strong hire here from a competent one. First, you learn each service's workflow well enough to coach its lead, inspect what it produces and challenge its estimates, and you know where your knowledge stops: on professional questions, you rely on the specialists. Second, you make different services run as one, with a shared way of taking requests, planning capacity and checking work, so the rest of Contour deals with one group rather than a row of separate desks.
This is a player-coach seat, and we mean it. Expect a real share of most weeks to go on doing the work yourself: running a cross-team project end to end, taking the coordination nobody else can untangle, checking a sample of finished work, mapping a process that keeps stalling or rebuilding an estimate from the ground up. The rest goes on making your coordinators, project managers and pod leads better at the same work. You won't be the specialist in every service, but you can work inside each one's workflow, and your team sees you do it. Contour is scaling and hires for the long term: the scope of this seat grows with the platform, and what you deliver decides how fast. The intake, planning, quality and automation routines you set now are what every later service joins.

What you will do

  • Run work yourself:lead some cross-team projects and coordination directly, especially the messy ones, so you know first-hand what your team is up against.
  • Lead the coordinators and project managers:set how projects and department requests are scoped, tracked and closed, review their plans and status updates, and step in when work slips.
  • Map every service's workflow with the people who run it and document it in Notionso anyone can follow it.
  • Run one front door for requests:a single intake form with clear turnaround times, so the rest of Contour deals with one group.
  • Plan capacity weeklyusing live dashboards of demand, turnaround and backlog, not gut feel.
  • Automate the repeatable:spot manual handoffs, data entry and status chasing, and work with the Internal Product team to automate them (for example with Monday, Notion, Slack, Google Workspace or no-code tools).
  • Use AI where it saves time:first-pass quality checks, drafting SOPs, summarising requests, with people keeping the final call.
  • Inspect quality:review samples of finished work against each owner's standard and fix repeat faults at the source.
  • Challenge estimatesagainst past jobs before they reach the business, and agree any change with whoever owns the work.
  • Keep functional owners informedon demand, risk and capacity, and turn their priorities into your team's plan.
  • Coach directly:structured 1:1s and performance conversations with your reports. Help any pod leads do the same, and make sure everyone knows who relies on their work.
  • Grow the group:build the case when a service needs a hire, a tool or a better process. Hiring goes ahead once the owner confirms approved headcount and budget. Bring a new service into the group only when it fits the pooled model.

Requirements

What you need
We weigh what you have built and run more than years on a CV. You should be able to point to:
  • Teams from more than one discipline that you led and answered for, including one outside your own field.
  • Projects you ran end to end while leading a team.
  • Aworkflow you mapped and rebuilt with the people who run it, which they still use.
  • A manual process you automated or moved onto a tool, with time saved or errors cut.
  • A dashboard or report you built that people used to make decisions.
  • An estimate or plan you pushed back on with evidence, and what changed.
  • People you managed directly, including coordinators or project managers and leads of their own teams.
Comfortable with workflow tools (Monday, Notion, Jira or similar), spreadsheets and dashboards, and curious about AI and no-code tools. You don't need to be an engineer.
If you have delivered these, or can show us how you would here, apply. If you enjoy hands-on work, this seat will suit you; if your recent years have mostly been signing off other people's work, it may feel small.
Nice to have
  • Shared services, a GCC or a team serving colleagues in another country.
  • Education or a student-facing business.
  • Hands-on time with automation tools (Zapier, Make, n8n or Apps Script) or process methods such as Lean.
What good looks like after 6 months
  • One front door:anyone at Contour knows how to ask for work and when they will hear back.
  • Dates that hold:the dates your teams give are the dates work lands.
  • Projects that land:cross-team projects run by your group finish on the dates and scope agreed.
  • Less manual work:the top repeat handoffs in your group are automated or removed.
  • Leads who decide:your coordinators and pod leads make daily calls without waiting for you.

Benefits

Fully remote, anywhere in India, working across the India and Australia time difference. Pay is benchmarked to the role and discussed openly early in the process.
​
Ready to lead from the front: run the work, coach the people and automate what slows them down? Apply.

Epic Cadence Application Analyst, Remote Eligible, Jacksonville, Baptist Health Digital Solutions Center

Epic Cadence Application Analyst to support, maintain, and optimize critical patient access and scheduling applications across the organization. Serving as a vital liaison between clinical operations, patient access teams, and Information Technology, this role ensures Epic applications effectively support operational workflows, enhance efficiency, and deliver a seamless experience for patients, providers, and staff. The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of healthcare operations, patient scheduling processes, and Epic system functionality, with the ability to translate operational needs into effective technical solutions that promote system integrity, automation, and continuous improvement.


The Epic Cadence Application Analyst is responsible for providing comprehensive application support, including troubleshooting and resolving break/fix issues, performing routine system maintenance, monitoring and investigating interface errors, and ensuring overall system stability and performance. Responsibilities also include implementing and validating Epic quarterly updates, collaborating with Epic technical support and internal application teams, and evaluating workflows to proactively identify and resolve potential disruptions. The analyst will work closely with multidisciplinary stakeholders to address technical challenges, support complementary workflows, and maintain reliable application functionality across the organization. Effective communication and coordination through email, Microsoft Teams, and scheduled meetings are essential to managing priorities, resolving issues, and ensuring continuity of critical patient access operations.

The Epic Cadence team supports a broad range of patient access capabilities, including patient and online scheduling, provider scheduling templates, referral and authorization workflows, Hello World SMS patient communications, Contact Center and Cheers customer service messaging, new outpatient department implementations, clinic relocations, Epic Nova maintenance, and third-party solutions such as Hyro. The analyst will collaborate across application teams and operational departments to coordinate projects, develop application-specific enhancements, optimize existing workflows, and support strategic initiatives aligned with organizational priorities. This position requires a proactive, collaborative, and solutions-oriented professional who can effectively balance production support, system optimization, and project responsibilities while contributing to Baptist Health's continued growth and commitment to delivering exceptional patient care.

Epic Cadence Application Analyst, you will be responsible for:

  • The role ensures the operational effectiveness of enterprise applications, addressing user needs while assisting with incidents, updates, and upgrades to maintain system health.

Redwood Automation Engineer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance, Iceland

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Iceland. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance close on Redwood, connected to SAP. Redwood Finance Automation runs on the same Redwood platform as RunMyJobs. SAP sold that platform for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and later SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). If you have built on it under any of those names, the experience carries straight across.

The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting, all running against SAP. You will build what the solution design sets out and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.

What you will work on

The close built as Redwood process definitions: task lists, dependencies, parameters and calendars, including SAP factory calendars. Automated steps that run the SAP FI/CO period-end programs in the background, in the right order and with the right variants. Balance sheet reconciliation, accruals and journal posting automated on the platform. Logic in REL and RedwoodScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. The connection to SAP S/4HANA or ECC through XBP and RFC. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.

What you bring

Hands-on build on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. You built the process definitions or job chains yourself. REL and RedwoodScript. SAP connections through XBP and RFC on at least one live SAP estate. Knowledge of the SAP FI/CO programs that run at month-end and the order they run in. 5 or more years in SAP automation, job scheduling or finance systems engineering.

Useful but not essential:

A migration from SAP BPA or SAP CPS to RunMyJobs. Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). SAP Financial Closing cockpit or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood, SAP CPS or SAP BPA work: what you automated, the SAP system it ran against, and what you built yourself.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP automation people in front of the client.

About Us:Comfrt LLC is the fastest growing ecommerce brand built on a mission to support mental health and create everything comfortable for an easy, stress-free, cozy lifestyle, we are obsessed with our customer and dedicated to building the ultimate comfort brand ecosystem.

About the Job:We are seeking an experienced Merchandise Coordinator to manage day-to-day purchase order entry, SKU creation, and product data maintenance while supporting reporting and process improvement. Reporting to the Merchandising Operations Manager, this role maintains clean, reliable data across systems, keeps orders current, and follows through on cross-functional deadlines.
The coordinator works closely with Merchandising, Product, Sourcing, Production, Supply Chain, Operations, Planning, and eCommerce. The ideal candidate brings at least 4 years of relevant experience, is comfortable working with large datasets, and communicates proactively. They take ownership of established workflows, resolve routine discrepancies, and escalate issues requiring decisions or approval.

Responsibilities:

Purchase Order Entry and Coordination

  • Enter purchase orders in Fulfill or the designated order management system using approved buy information and confirmed vendor details.
  • Meet PO entry and issuance deadlines, proactively coordinating required inputs and approvals and escalating delays to keep orders on schedule.
  • Process approved PO revisions and delivery updates, maintain change records, and share updated information with relevant teams.
  • Check style numbers, SKUs, size and color breakdowns, quantities, costs, vendor codes, and delivery dates against approved source documents; flag missing or conflicting information before entry.
  • Coordinate with Product, Sourcing, and Production to obtain required inputs and approvals; follow established PO handoff and distribution procedures.
  • Keep open order trackers current, follow up on outstanding information, and escalate delays or discrepancies to the manager.
  • Support reconciliation of ordered, shipped, and received quantities with Supply Chain and Operations; document discrepancies for resolution.

SKU Creation and Integrity

  • Create and maintain SKUs for approved styles, colors, and sizes following established naming conventions and setup procedures.
  • Maintain product attributes and SKU mappings across product records, purchase orders, and operational systems; check for duplicates, missing fields, and inconsistencies.
  • Work with Operations to verify SKU information supports accurate inventory tracking, receiving, and fulfillment.
  • Partner with eCommerce to verify SKUs transfer accurately to the website and map to the correct product variants.
  • Maintain traceability across SKU records, POs, inventory, and website listings; flag mapping issues and support corrections with manager guidance.

Cross Functional Communication and Follow Up

  • Maintain clear, timely communication with cross-functional partners about PO status, SKU setup, missing inputs, and upcoming deadlines.
  • Track outstanding requests, follow up proactively, and communicate blockers early with the information needed to resolve them.
  • Document decisions and approved changes so teams work from current information; escalate questions requiring approval to the appropriate owner.

Reporting and Process Support

  • Maintain PO, SKU readiness, and product data trackers, reports, and dashboards that support merchandising, product development, and operational decisions.
  • Compile, validate, and review order, inventory, and sales data to highlight trends, exceptions, and discrepancies; support inventory planning, product performance reviews, and operational KPIs under the manager’s direction.
  • Identify recurring data quality issues and partner with the manager and cross-functional teams to improve workflows and prevent errors.
  • Document data workflows, reporting logic, and system procedures; help streamline or automate recurring reporting where practical.
  • Support system updates and ERP or PLM implementation activities through data cleanup, record validation, testing, and training as directed.
  • Participate in regular coaching and training to strengthen system knowledge, communication, and independent execution.

Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of relevant experience in merchandising operations, product operations, purchasing, supply chain coordination, or operational data management.
  • Hands-on experience with PO entry and ongoing management, SKU creation, and product master data integrity.
  • Strong Excel proficiency, including pivot tables, lookup functions, data validation, and reconciliation of large datasets.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience identifying data discrepancies and maintaining accurate operational reporting.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines while maintaining accuracy.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, proactive follow-up, and a collaborative approach to working across teams.
  • Ability to follow approval processes, recognize discrepancies, and escalate issues promptly.
  • Receptiveness to feedback, willingness to learn new systems, and consistent follow-through on assigned work.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Merchandising, Supply Chain, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • A creative problem solver. You enjoy improving products and processes.
  • Fast but disciplined. You know how to move quickly while maintaining high standards.
  • Accountable. You take ownership of your work and follow through.
  • Collaborative. You work well cross-functionally and communicate clearly with internal teams and vendors.
  • Comfortable in a high-growth environment. You thrive where expectations are high and priorities move quickly.

Nice to Have:

  • Apparel, home goods, retail, or e-commerce experience.
  • Familiarity with Fulfill, NetSuite, PLM, or other product, inventory, or purchase order management systems.
  • Experience with SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting tools; familiarity with workflow automation.
  • Hands-on experience with SKU mapping and reconciliation across ERP, PLM, inventory, and eCommerce systems.
  • Strong interest in matching and validating SKU records, investigating discrepancies, and ensuring accurate, complete, and consistent information across systems.
  • Understanding of style, color, and size structures and how product data connects to inventory and website listings.
  • Basic knowledge of forecasting, inventory management, or S&OP processes.
  • Experience working in a remote or hybrid environment, with the professional judgment and accountability to work independently while staying highly collaborative and communicative.

Why Join Comfrt?

  • Be part of a purpose-driven company that’s shaping the future of comfort and mental wellness.
  • Work in a supportive, creative environment where your ideas and growth are valued.
  • Enjoy Comfrt benefits such as generous paid time off, company-covered health insurance, 5% 401k match, and discounts on all Comfrt products!
  • Join a passionate team making an impact on exciting projects, all while enjoying the flexibility and collaborative support of a fully remote environment.

Comfort is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive, target-driven Inside Sales Executive to drive lead generation and business development activities for our AI, Data Analytics, and Digital Transformation services across the APAC region, primarily focusing on the Singapore market.

The candidate will be responsible for identifying and reaching out to senior decision-makers, including C-level executives, IT Directors, CIOs, CTOs, Heads of Data, and other technology leaders within IT companies and enterprises.

The primary objective is to generate qualified business leads, initiate conversations with potential clients, qualify opportunities, and arrange meetings between prospective customers and our senior sales/business leadership team to explore potential AI and Data project opportunities.

The role will be performed remotely from an offshore location, requiring strong communication skills, confidence in engaging senior stakeholders, and the ability to build a consistent sales pipeline in the Singapore market.

Key Responsibilities

1. Lead Generation & Prospect Identification

  • Identify potential customers, target companies, and business opportunities across Singapore and the wider APAC market.
  • Build and maintain a database of IT companies, enterprises, financial institutions, and other potential customers.
  • Research organisations to identify relevant decision-makers, including CEOs, CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, IT Directors, and Heads of Data and Analytics.
  • Generate leads through LinkedIn, online research, company databases, networking platforms, and other prospecting channels.

2. Outbound Calling & C-Level Engagement

  • Conduct outbound cold calls and email campaigns to prospective customers.
  • Proactively reach out to C-level executives, business heads, IT leaders, and technology decision-makers.
  • Introduce our AI, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, and Digital Transformation capabilities.
  • Initiate meaningful business conversations and create interest in our technology services.
  • Build relationships with senior stakeholders and identify potential business requirements.

3. Lead Qualification & Opportunity Identification

  • Understand the prospect's business challenges, technology landscape, and potential IT requirements.
  • Identify opportunities related to AI/ML, Generative AI, Data Engineering, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Cloud Data Platforms, and Digital Transformation.
  • Qualify leads based on business needs, project potential, budget, decision-making authority, and timelines.
  • Maintain accurate records of prospect interactions, follow-ups, and lead status.

4. Meeting Arrangement & Sales Pipeline Development

  • Schedule qualified business meetings between prospective customers and the internal sales/business leadership team.
  • Ensure meetings are arranged with relevant decision-makers and stakeholders.
  • Share meeting briefs, prospect information, business requirements, and opportunity details with the internal team.
  • Conduct consistent follow-ups to convert initial conversations into meaningful business discussions.
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified leads and sales opportunities.

5. Market Research & Reporting

  • Research the Singapore IT services market and identify potential business opportunities.
  • Track competitor activities, market trends, and emerging AI and Data technology requirements.
  • Provide regular reports on calls made, prospects contacted, leads generated, meetings arranged, and qualified opportunities.
  • Maintain CRM records and ensure timely follow-ups with prospects.

Target Audience

The candidate will primarily engage with:

  • CEOs, CIOs, CTOs and CDOs.
  • Chief Digital Officers and Chief Technology Officers.
  • IT Directors and Heads of Technology.
  • Heads of Data, Analytics and AI.
  • Heads of Enterprise Architecture and Digital Transformation.
  • Business Development and Technology Leaders.

Target Organisations: IT services companies, consulting firms, banks, financial institutions, insurance companies, fintech organisations, and large enterprises across Singapore and APAC.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in Inside Sales, Telecalling, Lead Generation, B2B Sales, or Business Development within the IT industry.
  • Proven experience in outbound calling, cold calling, and B2B prospecting.
  • Ability to confidently communicate with senior-level executives and C-level stakeholders.
  • Experience generating leads and arranging business meetings for IT services or technology solutions.
  • Good understanding of IT services, AI, Data Analytics, Cloud, and Digital Transformation concepts.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Strong research, prospecting, follow-up, and relationship-building capabilities.
  • Experience using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, CRM platforms, and lead-generation tools will be an advantage.
  • Self-motivated, target-oriented, and comfortable working independently from an offshore location.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be measured based on:

  • Number of targeted companies and decision-makers identified.
  • Number of outbound calls and meaningful conversations.
  • Number of qualified leads generated.
  • Number of meetings successfully arranged with C-level and senior IT stakeholders.
  • Number of sales-qualified opportunities created.
  • Consistency of follow-ups and development of the sales pipeline.

Preferred Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is confident, persistent, and commercially driven, with the ability to pick up the phone, approach senior executives, open business conversations, and create opportunities from scratch.

The ideal candidate should have a strong hunter mindset, be comfortable with cold calling, and possess the confidence to engage decision-makers in Singapore-based IT companies and enterprises.

Success in this role is defined by the ability to generate quality leads, establish connections with senior decision-makers, and consistently arrange qualified business meetings that create opportunities for AI and Data projects.

      <title>Mercury: Business Continuity Management Lead</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States
</p>

<h3><strong>About the Role</strong></h3>
<p>Mercury is seeking a Business Continuity Management (BCM) Lead to build and lead an enterprise-wide continuity program as we prepare to become a bank. As part of the Risk team, this leader will establish practical standards, clear accountability, and tested capabilities to maintain critical services and recover effectively from disruptions, with direct visibility to the CRO and senior leadership.</p>
<p>This role fills the need for a dedicated leader to coordinate BCM across the organization. The ideal candidate combines deep continuity and resilience expertise with the judgment to build a proportionate program in a fast-moving environment, working effectively with Engineering, Operations, Product, Information Security, Legal, Compliance, and business teams.</p>
<p>The BCM Lead will own the enterprise framework, coordination, oversight, and reporting. Business and technology owners will remain accountable for their continuity plans and recovery execution.Because this is a new program, the Lead will be hands-on in the initial build: facilitating the first round of BIAs and plans side by side with owners, running exercises, and driving identified gaps through remediation. This leader will also work closely with Engineering on technology disaster recovery and with relevant teams on incident response, crisis management, and third-party resilience.</p>
<h3><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Develop and implement Mercury’s enterprise BCM framework, policies, standards, governance, and operating model, with a prioritized implementation roadmap aligned to bank-launch readiness and critical services.</li>
<li>Partner with business owners to identify critical services, conduct business impact analyses (customer, financial, operational, and regulatory), and map dependencies across people, processes, technology, facilities, and third parties, including single points of failure.</li>
<li>Establish recovery time objectives (RTOs) and recovery point objectives (RPOs), where applicable, with business and technology owners; challenge gaps between objectives and recovery capabilities.</li>
<li>Set standards for continuity plans and recovery procedures, and facilitate and support accountable owners in developing actionable plans and alternative operating arrangements.</li>
<li>Coordinate business continuity with technology disaster recovery, incident response, and crisis management, with clear activation criteria, escalation paths, and communications responsibilities.</li>
<li>Design and lead a risk-based exercise program, from tabletop simulations to end-to-end recovery tests, and drive lessons learned, remediation tracking, and verification that gaps are closed.</li>
<li>Partner with Third-Party Risk Management and vendor owners to assess critical provider recovery capabilities, contingency arrangements, and concentration dependencies.</li>
<li>Embed continuity considerations into new products, material business changes, and technology implementations.</li>
<li>Establish metrics and reporting that give management and relevant committees visibility into readiness, testing outcomes, material gaps, and overdue remediation.</li>
<li>Build and lead a growing BCM team, including hiring and developing analysts as the program scales over the next year.</li>
<li>Deliver role-based training and promote awareness of continuity responsibilities across the organization.</li>
<li>Support regulatory examinations and bank-launch readiness reviews with accurate documentation and evidence of recovery capability.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Qualifications</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>10+ years of experience in business continuity management, operational resilience, disaster recovery, or a related discipline within a fintech, financial institution, technology company, or other highly regulated environment.</li>
<li>Demonstrated experience building or materially enhancing an enterprise BCM program, including governance, implementation, testing, and reporting.</li>
<li>Strong skills in business impact analysis, critical-service identification, dependency mapping, and recovery objective development.</li>
<li>Experience developing actionable continuity plans and leading exercises that test recovery assumptions and expose gaps.</li>
<li>Sufficient technical fluency to work with Engineering on cloud services, system dependencies, data recovery, and technology disaster recovery.</li>
<li>Working knowledge of third-party risk management, including assessing critical vendor recovery capabilities, contingency arrangements and concentration risk.</li>
<li>Proven ability to drive cross-functional remediation through influence, with a clear view of where BCM oversight ends and business or technology ownership begins.</li>
<li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain readiness gaps and tradeoffs to senior leadership.</li>
<li>Experience managing a team of Business Continuity analysts.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Familiarity with banking supervisory expectations for business continuity, and operational resilience.</li>
<li>Experience operating in a company-building or bank-building environment.</li>
<li>Familiarity with recognized continuity standards, such as ISO 22301, and BCM tools for plan management, exercises, and issue tracking.</li>
<li>Relevant professional certification, such as CBCP or MBCI.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Leadership Attributes</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Pragmatic, first-principles builder who turns ambiguous needs into clear priorities and designs a program that fits Mercury’s operations and scale.</li>
<li>Takes ownership and follows through from identified gaps to demonstrated recovery.</li>
<li>Collaborative, low-ego, and effective across the three lines of defense.</li>
<li>Calm under pressure and able to facilitate clear decisions during disruptions.</li>
<li>Able to challenge constructively, distinguish material gaps from theoretical concerns, and avoid over-engineering.</li>
</ul>
<p>*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.</p>
<p>Mercury values diversity &amp; belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.</p>
<p>#LI-DR1</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong><br>The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits.</p>
<p>Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the SaaS and fintech industry and are updated regularly using the most reliable compensation survey data for our industry. New hire offers are made based on a candidate’s experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers.</p>

      <title>OfferUp: Software Development Engineer II (Remote @ Colombia)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote @ Colombia
</p>

<p><strong>About the role:&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>The OfferUp Connect team builds the moments that turn a listing into a sale. Every chat between buyers and sellers, every offer notification, and every saved-search alert runs through services we own, from messaging and notifications to location, meetups, and the subscriptions sellers pay for. We run high-volume Java microservices and streaming pipelines, integrate with partners like Braze, Amazon Pinpoint, Apple, and Google, and use experimentation to decide what ships.</p>
<p>We also take on high-visibility work beyond our domain. Connect built OfferUp's video infrastructure for listing videos and LLM-powered catalog enrichment on Amazon Bedrock, both company priorities that changed what buyers see every day. The roadmap is wide open for someone who wants to help shape it.</p>
<p>As a Software Development Engineer II, you'll own features from concept to rollout: designing and writing well-tested code, launching experiments, and measuring results with Product, Design, and Data partners. You'll raise the quality of the code around you and get the chance to join the next project like video or catalog enrichment.</p>
<p><strong>Here’s more of what you will get to do:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Design, build, and deploy backend services and event-driven pipelines for messaging, notifications, location, and subscriptions</li>
<li>Improve the reliability, latency, and delivery rates of high-volume messaging and notification systems, including retries, rate limiting, and frequency capping</li>
<li>Integrate with and operate third-party platforms such as Braze, Amazon Pinpoint, Apple and Google push services, and app store billing</li>
<li>Own features end-to-end: plan, design, develop, deploy, measure, and iterate</li>
<li>Break down complex engineering problems into achievable tasks and deliver them within committed timeframes</li>
<li>Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams (Product, Design, Data Science, Marketing, and iOS, Android, and web engineers) to design and implement new features</li>
<li>Contribute to A/B tests and use experimentation results to decide what ships</li>
<li>Actively participate in code reviews and enforce good patterns, testing, and edge-case handling</li>
<li>Coach and mentor junior team members, new hires, and interns</li>
<li>Create shared components, utilities, and services that improve team velocity across the stack</li>
<li>Maintain and improve the runbooks, alerting, and monitoring for the features you ship</li>
<li>Participate in a reasonable on-call rotation with the rest of the team</li>
<li>Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Gemini, and similar) to increase your daily development velocity and code quality</li>
<li>Become a subject matter expert in one or more of the team's sub-domains: messaging, notifications and campaigns, location, or subscriptions and promotions</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>You’ll thrive in this role if you have:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>2+ years of professional software engineering experience</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to own the delivery of multiple features end-to-end (plan, design, develop, and deploy) with high efficiency, including breaking down engineering problems into achievable tasks</li>
<li>Strong coding skills in Java, with a working understanding of microservices and distributed-systems fundamentals</li>
<li>Good knowledge of data structures and object-oriented design</li>
<li>Working knowledge of asynchronous, event-driven systems (queues, pub/sub, or streams), including retries and idempotent processing</li>
<li>Hands-on experience using AI coding tools (Claude Code or similar) in a real engineering workflow, and a point of view on when they help and when they don't</li>
<li>A habit of following good coding patterns, writing appropriate tests, considering trade-offs, and seeking out edge cases</li>
<li>Comfortable giving and receiving feedback in code reviews</li>
<li>A bias toward shipping, learning from production, and iterating quickly</li>
<li>An insatiable desire and ability to learn</li>
<li>BS or MS in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Helpful, but not required:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Fluency in another modern object-oriented programming language</li>
<li>Experience with TypeScript and Node.js</li>
<li>Experience with Agile development</li>
<li>Experience building and integrating with REST APIs</li>
<li>Experience with AWS services such as DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, Lambda, and ElastiCache (Redis)</li>
<li>Experience with notification and engagement platforms (Braze, Amazon Pinpoint, APNs, FCM) or in-app subscription billing (App Store, Google Play)</li>
<li>Experience with stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink or Kafka Streams</li>
<li>Experience with A/B testing platforms (Statsig, LaunchDarkly, Optimizely) and analytics warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake)</li>
<li>Experience consuming or integrating LLM-based APIs (e.g., Bedrock, Vertex AI, OpenAI)</li>
<li>Familiarity with Kubernetes, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines</li>
</ul>
<p><br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About OfferUp:</strong></p>
<p>OfferUp is dedicated to creating the simplest and most trusted way for people to buy, sell, and connect in their local communities. One of the top local marketplace apps for local buyers and sellers in the U.S., OfferUp makes it easy for people to discover more of what they need—from great deals and secondhand goods to jobs, services, home rentals, and more—right in their own communities. Our trusted platform empowers millions to connect, thrive, and move life forward.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Available on iOS and Android, OfferUp has consistently ranked among the top shopping apps. Founded in 2011 and based in Bellevue, WA, OfferUp serves local markets nationwide and was used by more than 1 in 6 adults in the U.S. in 2024. OfferUp is backed by leading investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Warburg Pincus, GGV Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Coatue Management. https://about.offerup.com</p>
<p><strong>More About OfferUp At a Glance</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Top 10 Shopping app in the App Store and Google Play Store for three years</li>
<li>15%+ of adults in several major markets use OfferUp every month (LA, Miami, Phoenix, Seattle, Las Vegas, Riverside, Orlando)</li>
<li>OfferUp works directly with nearly 2000 US law enforcement agencies to build trust in local communities</li>
</ul>
<p><em>OfferUp is unleashing the power of local, and we’ve built a dynamic team to do it. To learn more about working at OfferUp, check out </em><a href="https://about.offerup.com/people"><em>https://about.offerup.com/people</em></a><em>&nbsp;</em></p>
<p><em>OfferUp provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, OfferUp complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.</em></p>
<p><em>OfferUp expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. Improper interference with the ability of OfferUp’s employees to perform their job duties may result in discipline up to and including discharge.</em></p></div>

      <title>Maven Clinic: Head of Member Growth (B2B2C)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com</p>
<p><strong>An award-winning culture working towards an important mission –&nbsp; Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including:&nbsp;</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)</li>
<li>Fortune Change the World (2024)</li>
<li>CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)</li>
<li>Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)</li>
<li>Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)</li>
<li>Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)</li>
<li>Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)</li>
</ul></div><h4>About the Role:</h4>
<p>Maven is looking for a Head of Member Growth to own one of the most important numbers in the company: enrollments. This role is directly accountable for driving member enrollment into Maven's programs across our core business — and, by extension, the revenue those enrollments generate. You will own the enrollment engine end to end, from awareness through activation, turning eligible lives into engaged members.</p>
<p>Enrollment is not a single-team problem. It sits at the intersection of nearly every function at Maven, and this role is built for someone who thrives there. You'll partner daily with Client Success (who own the client relationships that unlock eligible populations), Marketing (member acquisition and lifecycle), Product (enrollment experience and funnel), Finance (targets, forecasting, and unit economics), Data (measurement, segmentation, and attribution), and Clinical and Operations teams. Because so many teams touch enrollment, a core part of the job is holding those cross-functional partners accountable to their piece of the machine — the engine only works when every team delivers its part.</p>
<p>This is a player-coach role. You will lead a small, high-caliber team while remaining deeply hands-on yourself every day. Although it carries a Senior Director title, it is explicitly NOT a leaned-out management position for someone who wants to direct a team from a distance. This is a hard requirement: the person in this seat reads the data themselves, pressure-tests the funnel, drafts the plan, and does the work alongside the team. We are looking for a builder and operator who also develops people — not a manager who has stepped away from the work.</p>
<p>We're also looking for someone who can expand the definition of the job. A great deal of enrollment optimization work is already underway, but there is not enough strategic thinking about fundamentally new ways to drive enrollments — approaches that don't simply depend on securing permission to communicate with a client's employees. This role is expected to find and open those new avenues, not just optimize the existing ones.</p>
<h4>What You'll Do:</h4>
<ul>
<li><strong>Own member growth for the Core Business:</strong> Be directly accountable for enrollment targets across Maven's core business and for the revenue those enrollments drive. Set the strategy, build the plan, and act as a control tower across all cross-functional teams driving revenue to deliver the results quarter over quarter.</li>
<li><strong>Build and run a scalable enrollment engine</strong>: Own the full journey from eligible population to enrolled, activated member — spanning client launches, member acquisition and messaging, the enrollment product experience, and re-engagement of eligible-but-not-enrolled members.</li>
<li><strong>Expand the playbook and deliver new strategies to drive sustainable member growth</strong>: Think strategically and from first principles about new ways to grow enrollments beyond today's optimization work — including partnerships and approaches that don't rely solely on permission to communicate with a client's employees. Identify, size, and open avenues that expand the team's purview and unlock new growth.&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Optimize relentlessly around data</strong>: Build and consistently iterate on the funnel, and create systems that enable quick diagnoses of opportunities. Build operational metrics that act as leading KPIs for each team contributing to enrollments and bring quantitative rigor into how teams execute against targets.</li>
<li><strong>Hold the cross-functional machine accountable</strong>: Partner daily with Client Success, Marketing, Product, Finance, Data, Clinical, Payer, Sales, and Operations — and hold each team accountable to its operational KPIs in the enrollment process. Serve as the connective tissue that keeps every part of the engine delivering.</li>
<li><strong>Operate as a player-coach</strong>: Lead and develop a small, high-performing team while staying in the execution and details. Set the bar for rigor and hands-on execution by doing the work, coaching through it, and multiplying the team's impact rather than stepping back from it. This is a role that comes with an expectation that you directly execute on the work.</li>
<li><strong>Instrument and forecast</strong>: Partner with Data and Finance to build the measurement, segmentation, attribution, and forecasting needed to know exactly what is and isn't working, and to forecast enrollment and revenue with confidence.</li>
</ul>
<h4>What You'll Bring:</h4>
<ul>
<li>10+ years of experience driving growth, enrollment, acquisition, or revenue outcomes, with a track record of personally owning and hitting a number — ideally in healthcare, benefits, marketplaces, consumer subscription, or another environment with a complex funnel and multiple stakeholders.</li>
<li>A hands-on player-coach. You are energized by being in the details daily — the data, the funnel, the plan, the execution — and you lead a small team as a way to multiply your own hands-on impact, not to step back from the work. This is a hard requirement for the role.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Elite quantitative ability as a core competency. You can build and interrogate a funnel model yourself, size opportunities, design experiments, and instinctively optimize around data rather than intuition. Strong quant is non-negotiable.</li>
<li>Strategic range. Beyond optimizing what exists, you can spot and pursue fundamentally new approaches to enrollment that expand the team's purview — not just incremental improvements to current channels.</li>
<li>Cross-functional leadership and accountability. Proven ability to align and mobilize many teams — Client Success, Marketing, Product, Finance, Data, Clinical, Operations — around a shared goal without direct authority over most of them, and to hold each accountable to its operational commitments.</li>
<li>Commercial instincts. You understand how enrollment translates into revenue and unit economics, and you can partner with Finance on targets and forecasting.</li>
<li>Comfort in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment with high visibility and direct accountability for a top-line company metric.</li>
</ul>
<p>The base salary range for this role is $204,000.00 - $270,000.00 per year. You will also be entitled to receive bonus, equity, and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on qualifications, experience, and skillset.</p>
<p><strong>This role requires active work authorization in the US.</strong></p>
<p>Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, and remotely via San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, Seattle, WA. For those in our New York City office, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to work onsite three days a week&nbsp; (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). For those based in Boston, DC, Chicago, Seattle, and San Francisco, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend monthly Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p class="p1">At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams.</p>
<p><strong>Benefits That Work For You</strong></p>
<p>Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits:</p>
<ul>
<li>Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics.</li>
<li>Whole-self care through wellness partnerships</li>
<li>Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days&nbsp;</li>
<li>16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+)</li>
<li>Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens</li>
<li>401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits.&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Maven Clinic interview requests and job offers only originate from an @mavenclinic.com email address (e.g jsmith@mavenclinic.com). Maven Clinic will never ask for sensitive information to be delivered over email or phone. <span>If you receive a scam issue or a security issue involving Maven Clinic please notify us at: </span><a href="mailto:security@mavenclinic.com"><span>security@mavenclinic.com</span></a><span>. </span>For general and additional inquiries, please contact us at&nbsp;<a href="mailto:careers@mavenclinic.com">careers@mavenclinic.com</a>.&nbsp;</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/maven-clinic-head-of-member-growth-b2b2c">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/maven-clinic-head-of-member-growth-b2b2c</a></p>
</description>

Our first product, Infernet, is pioneering new ground as the first solution to enable developers to access AI models both on-chain via smart contracts and off-chain, demonstrating our commitment to bridging these transformative technologies.</p></div><h4>About the role</h4>

You'll work on expanding the execution layer to support novel precompiles, implement parallel execution patterns, and design systems for heterogeneous compute orchestration.</p>

<li>Thorough knowledge of Ethereum's roadmap and active participation in protocol discussions</li>

<li>Strong understanding of consensus mechanisms and blockchain architecture</li>
<li>Ability to read, understand, and implement EIPs and protocol specifications</li>

<li>Ability to act quickly under high pressure scenarios and context switch at a high frequency</li>

<li>Hungry, high-energy and ability to work within and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment</li>
</ul>

<li>Background in mechanism design or market systems</li>
<li>Deep knowledge of proof systems and their trade-offs around prover time, verifier time, and proof size</li>

      <title>Celonis: Client Value Partner (CVP) - Utilities & Energy Industry</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, US, Ohio
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.</p></div><h2><strong>The Opportunity</strong></h2>
<p>We are seeking an established consulting leader—a current Big Four Director, Managing Director, or Partner-track Senior Manager—to spearhead our highest-stakes Energy &amp; Utilities engagements. In this executive-level role, you will serve as the principal strategic architect for our most valuable power, gas, and renewable energy accounts globally.</p>
<p>Leveraging the Celonis Process Intelligence platform, you will bridge the gap between macro energy sector strategies and modern cloud/AI execution models, moving clients from slide decks to realized operational value.<br><br></p>
<h2><strong>The Impact You’ll Make</strong></h2>
<h3><strong>1. C-Suite Advisory &amp; Value Architecture</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Peer-to-Peer Advisory:</strong> Partner directly with utility C-suite executives (CEOs, COOs, CFOs, Chief Sustainability Officers) to align macro pressures—decarbonization, grid modernization, and capital reallocation—with execution-level transformation roadmaps.</li>
<li><strong>Map Enterprise Digital Twins:</strong> Oversee the deployment of the Celonis Process Intelligence Graph to build systemic, end-to-end operational models of complex utility enterprises.</li>
<li><strong>Orchestrate $100M+ Business Cases:</strong> Direct the formulation of board-ready Celonis Value Assessments, delivering the economic justification, working capital improvements, and OPEX returns required to greenlight massive cloud and Edge AI investments.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>2. Transformation Leadership &amp; Ecosystem Governance</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Steer Enterprise Transformations:</strong> Serve as the executive sponsor for high-visibility, Celonis-driven operating model overhauls for Fortune 500 E&amp;U clients, guiding them from diagnostic discovery to closed-loop automation.</li>
<li><strong>Architect Celonis Centers of Excellence (CoEs):</strong> Design and establish corporate-wide CoEs, defining the target operating models, governance structures, and enablement frameworks needed to embed data-driven decision-making into client cultures.</li>
<li><strong>Untangle Systemic Friction:</strong> Lead cross-functional teams to resolve complex operational leakages where siloed utility stacks (SAP S/4HANA, IBM Maximo, ADMS/SCADA) collide—specifically optimizing capital procurement, field services, and energy settlement invoicing.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>3. Commercial Growth &amp; Scaled Innovation</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>De-Risk High-Value Sales Cycles:</strong> Convert complex regulatory mandates (FERC, NERC) into automated, visual compliance audits within the Celonis platform, transforming abstract compliance risks into compelling business cases that accelerate C-suite sign-off.</li>
<li><strong>Commercialize Next-Gen "Process + AI" Use Cases:</strong> Direct the integration of industrial telemetry (SCADA, Edge IoT) into Celonis, translating complex data structures into high-margin, executive-ready offerings like real-time storm response and predictive asset failure.</li>
<li><strong>Productize Utility Value Plays:</strong> Codify repeatable client successes into scalable Celonis apps and action templates, establishing a library of industry-specific intellectual property that drives rapid time-to-value, net-new ARR, and account expansion.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>The Profile We Are Looking For</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Consulting Pedigree:</strong> 12+ years of progressive experience within a Big Four or elite management consulting firm, currently operating at the Director, Managing Director, or Partner level.</li>
<li><strong>E&amp;U Vertical Expertise:</strong> Deep, authoritative knowledge of the Energy &amp; Utilities sector (Grid Operations, Transmission &amp; Distribution, Generation, or Retail), with a track record of leading multi-million-dollar transformation programs.</li>
<li><strong>SaaS &amp; Process Intelligence Vision:</strong> Strong conceptual understanding of Process Mining paradigms. Experience with Celonis is highly advantageous, but a proven ability to leverage enterprise software to reshape business processes is required.</li>
<li><strong>Architectural Fluency:</strong> Comprehensive understanding of the modern enterprise stack (SAP, Oracle, Maximo) and emerging data/AI paradigms (Azure AI, LLMs). <em>Note: You do not need to write code or SQL queries, but you must possess the technical fluency to direct data scientists, engineers, and solution architects.</em></li>
<li><strong>Commercial Acumen:</strong> Proven capability in client origination, relationship management, and driving account growth through value-based selling.</li>

      <title>Reddit: Analytics Engineer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - United States
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text">
<div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text">
<div class="p-block_kit_renderer">
<div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first">
<div class="p-rich_text_block">
<div class="p-rich_text_section">Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit <a class="c-link" href="http://www.redditinc.com/">www.redditinc.com</a>.</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div></div><p>We are looking for a talented and driven individual to be a key part of our Analytics Engineering team within the Data Science organization. We are looking for someone who can work closely with Data Scientists and Engineers across diverse areas of the organization (Consumer, Ads, and Marketing) to curate, develop, and deploy the right data and analytic tooling to drive Reddit’s product forward and provide a data and tooling foundation that will last decades. Your work will empower thousands of your colleagues to improve the user experience and grow our consumer base.</p>
<p>Successful candidates have a strong track record of understanding and deeply caring about the purpose of data to support business goals, and can act as an effective conduit between Data Producers and Data Consumers. This role sits at the intersection of Data Science and Data Engineering, and the ideal candidate has skills, experience, and passion in both areas.</p>
<p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Be a key contributor and collaborator to the success of data quality, performance, reliability, and automation initiatives.</li>
<li>Manage a portfolio of data products that deliver high-quality, trustworthy data</li>
<li>Develop and maintain robust data pipelines and workflows for data ingestion, processing, and transformation. Work closely with engineering to ensure the quality and reliability of these data pipelines.</li>
<li>Develop and implement data quality checks, conduct QA and implement monitoring routines</li>
<li>Create and manage new data integrations across internal and external systems</li>
<li>Create tools and applications for internal use that streamline data analysis and reporting. Drive widespread adoption of these tools and applications with a relentless focus on automation, consistency, and reliability.</li>
<li>Serve as a thought partner for data scientists, engineering managers, and leadership on data foundations, communicating and shaping the data foundations roadmap and strategy for Reddit.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Qualifications:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Bachelor's degree in computer science or a quant educational field</li>
<li>3+ years of experience working with large-scale ETL systems (implementation, strategy, and maintenance), building clean, maintainable code and systems (Python preferred) in a production environment.</li>
<li>Strong programming proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark, Scala, etc.</li>
<li>Experience with data modeling, ETL and ELT concepts, and patterns for efficient data governance. Experience with manipulating massive-scale structured and unstructured data.</li>
<li>Experience with data workflows (such as Airflow), data modeling, front-end or back-end engineering.</li>
<li>Experience in data analysis and dashboard design.</li>
<li>Deep understanding of technical and functional designs for relational and MPP Databases.</li>
<li>Proven track record of cross-functional execution and collaboration.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Agentic AI-assisted development experience.</li>
<li>Excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders at all levels of the company, of differing levels of technical acumen.</li>
<li>Self-starter, ability to work independently and autonomously, as well as part of a team.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p>Check out our r/RedditEng post to learn more about the team, and what we do: <a href="https://www.reddit.com/r/RedditEng/comments/1mnmf71/analytics_engineering_reddit/">https://www.reddit.com/r/RedditEng/comments/1mnmf71/analytics_engineering_reddit/</a>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Benefits:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs</li>
<li>401k with Employer Match</li>
<li>Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support</li>
<li>Family Planning Support</li>
<li>Gender-Affirming Care</li>
<li>Mental Health &amp; Coaching Benefits</li>
<li>Flexible Vacation &amp; Paid Volunteer Time Off</li>
<li>Generous Paid Parental Leave&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p>#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><strong>Pay Transparency:</strong></p>
<p>This job posting may span more than one career level.</p>
<p>In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit <a href="https://www.redditinc.com/careers/">https://www.redditinc.com/careers/</a>.</p>
<p>To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below.</p></div><div class="title">The base salary range for this position is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$164,200</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$229,990 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.</p>
<p><span>During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable.&nbsp; We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes.&nbsp; We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision.&nbsp; For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our <a href="https://redditinc.com/policies/candidate-privacy-policy">Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors</a>.</span></p>
<p><em><span>Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve.&nbsp; Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.</span></em></p></div>

      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0157/5402/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
